failure_summary.description: The full-name guidance encouraged unnecessary name parts when the expected conventional answer used a shorter name.
The answers reversed the requested direction of a title or name change, returning the altered title or former alias instead of the source or current name.
A terse officeholder prompt received a biographical description rather than the requested concise associated value.
The answer used a singular lowercase form where the gold answer was plural and capitalized.

patch.reasoning: Clarify the conflicting guidance on personal-name length and add a focused test for the direction of title and name changes. Avoid adding a pluralization rule that conflicts with the clue's singular wording, or repeating a broad bare-officeholder heuristic that is not clearly cued by the prompt.

edits.target: For a person, use an explicitly supported full personal name rather than a familiar nickname when the full name is relevant, and preserve honorifics that are part of the context-supported conventional name, especially when the clue cues them.
edits.content: For a person, match the name form and granularity cued by the question. Use a familiar or conventional short name when that is how the clue identifies the person; include middle initials, additional name parts, or a formal given name only when requested, cued, or needed to distinguish the person. Do not expand a name merely because context contains a fuller form. Preserve honorifics when the clue cues them or they are part of the established conventional name.

edits.target: - When an ellipsis marks omitted words in a title or phrase, use context to recover and return the missing continuation. Prefer a completion that fits the whole fragment over a prominent work or entity that matches only a shorter substring.
edits.content: - Track the direction of title and name changes. If a clue says a title was changed from A to B but asks for the original or source title, return A, not the altered title B; return B only when the altered title is requested. Likewise, when a current entity is identified by a former name, give the current name when that is the requested referent rather than repeating the former alias.
